description: React component for the SCADA Mapping Table page, including data processing, validation, and UI rendering for editing SCADA point mappings and displaying recommendations.

methods.name: safeArray
methods.description: Ensures the input is an array; returns empty array if not.

methods.name: pick
methods.description: Selects the first non-null value from an object based on provided keys.

methods.name: normalizeQuality
methods.description: Converts various quality indicators to standardized 'OK', 'Warning', or 'Error'.

methods.name: qualityPillStyle
methods.description: Returns style object for quality indicator pills based on quality status.

methods.name: isLikelyScadaPointName
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles a typical SCADA point name (uppercase, underscores, length).

methods.name: isLikelyLnInstance
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles an IEC 61850 LN instance (letters + digits).

methods.name: isLikely61850Path
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles a typical IEC 61850 DO/DA path (dot-separated).

methods.name: makeIdFromRowLike
methods.description: Creates a unique ID string for a SCADA row based on its properties.

methods.name: buildMockScadaRows
methods.description: Generates mock SCADA rows, optionally indicating issues based on validation results.

methods.name: toScadaRow
methods.description: Converts an object to a SCADA row with extracted properties.

methods.name: buildScadaRowsFromAppState
methods.description: Extracts SCADA rows from validation result data, trying multiple possible data shapes.

methods.name: computeRowIssues
methods.description: Analyzes a SCADA row to generate recommendations for issues.

methods.name: normalizeRecommendationsFromValidation
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes recommendations from validation result data.

methods.name: textInputStyle
methods.description: Returns style object for text inputs, optionally marking invalid.

methods.name: severityPillStyle
methods.description: Returns style object for severity indicator pills.

methods.name: ScadaTablePage
methods.description: Main React component for the SCADA Mapping Table page, managing state, rendering table, filters, and recommendations.
